entries.101e1247383c77c9: Develops and sells solar power plant equipment. Amounts are disclosed collectively within the renewable energy business, and no separate amounts are disclosed.
entries.10ecd479cc64f83c: To promote regional revitalization and regional development, it holds oyster-related events in the area where the purification center is located and offers fresh oysters from various parts of Japan. Amounts are disclosed together within “Other”, and there is no separate disclosure of amounts.
entries.184ab96710d15672: It sells raw oysters, fried oysters, original wine and sake, and other products on its own EC site. Amounts are disclosed together within “Other”, and there is no separate disclosure of amounts.
entries.1ae2e7c33be94b14: This business wholesales purified oysters to restaurant outlets outside the company's group. Drawing on the oyster volume used in the store business, it purchases intensively from oyster producers in various parts of the country. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, it did business with about 900 stores, and revenue from external customers was ¥443 million. The business is carried out by consolidated subsidiary Nihon Kaki Center Co., Ltd.
entries.283cbd8aaa60705f: This business manufactures oyster products, including “frozen oyster fry” and “frozen loose oysters (IQF)”, at a processing plant in Otsuchi Town, Iwate Prefecture. As it mainly performs a central kitchen function for Group stores, most of its sales are to the Group; revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥10 million. The company operates it.
entries.2d4806f74487a50d: Central kitchen (manufacture of oyster processed products)
entries.2faa7c6d27ab5a4c: A company that operates oyster bars specializing in oysters across Japan, and also handles oyster purification, wholesale, and the development and sale/purchase of solar power plants.
entries.3fc3e48bf8d4cb5c: Buyers of solar power plant equipment
entries.4190cf4445634655: This business is not included in reportable segments and consists of an event business that holds oyster-related events in the area where the purification center is located, and an EC business for mail-order sales, launched in August 2020. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥61 million.
entries.4bd31cd271d5f043: Franchising since the opening of the first store in Hokkaido in November 2023; as of the filing date, it operates three stores, including those in Osaka and Wakayama. Amounts are disclosed collectively within the restaurant business, and no separate amounts are disclosed.
entries.70a64578dde92b65: Store operation, including the store "Nyuzen Kaki no Hoshi" attached to the No. 2 Purification Center in Nyuzen Town, Shimo-Niikawa District, Toyama Prefecture. Amounts are disclosed collectively within the restaurant business, and no separate amounts are disclosed.
entries.7433475b1e3f18ba: A business started in January 2024 that develops and sells solar power plant equipment and generates and sells electricity from company-owned equipment. Revenue has been recognized since August 2025, and revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥613 million. This business is mainly carried out by the consolidated subsidiary GO Store Co., Ltd.
entries.975188220cdfc877: Development and sale of solar power plant equipment
entries.9dece95c4ae9897e: Group store business and wholesale business
entries.a1fb7f57e4bd754d: This is contract processing and manufacturing of seafood for outside parties. Amounts are disclosed together within the processing business, and there is no separate disclosure of amounts.
entries.e3a0b773e1ff925d: Power generation and sale from company-owned equipment
entries.e540e768fc0a7717: It manufactures frozen oyster fry, frozen loose oysters, pasta and other products for directly operated stores and franchise stores. Amounts are disclosed together within the processing business, and there is no separate disclosure of amounts.
entries.f0b5da54ae6fb619: This business operates oyster-focused restaurants (oyster bars) under several brands, including "8th SEA OYSTER Bar", mainly in department stores and commercial facilities in the Greater Tokyo Area; as of March 31, 2026, it operated 30 company-owned stores and 3 franchised stores. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,173 million. This business is mainly carried out by the consolidated subsidiary Human Web Co., Ltd.
entries.fa11a8c9733abc64: This business operates a purification center in Nyuzen Town, Shimo-Niikawa District, Toyama Prefecture, where it uses deep ocean water to purify oysters and ships them to the store business and the wholesale business. Most of its sales are to Group companies; revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2 million. The business is carried out by consolidated subsidiary Kaiyo Shinsui Kaki Center Co., Ltd.
entries.fc404c03ce343e38: An oyster bar operated by the company. Its main product is "Oyster Plate", an assortment of raw oysters from multiple production areas that offer flavors varying by origin and season, and it also serves grilled and steamed oysters. Amounts are disclosed collectively within the restaurant business, and no separate amounts are disclosed.
entries.fef3f60c0c0f51a3: Generates electricity with company-owned solar power equipment and sells the electricity. Amounts are disclosed collectively within the renewable energy business, and no separate amounts are disclosed.
